copper-hydroxide: An inorganic copper compound. Copper compounds act on plant surfaces.
azoxystrobin: A strobilurin fungicide. It interferes with energy production in fungi.
mandipropamid: A substance that interferes with cell-wall formation in certain oomycetes.
propamocarb-hydrochloride: A fungicidal substance that interferes with cell-membrane formation in certain oomycetes.
propamocarb: A fungicidal substance that interferes with cell-membrane formation in certain oomycetes.
difenoconazole: A triazole fungicide. It interferes with the production of sterols that fungi need for their membranes.
bacillus-amyloliquefaciens-strain-qst-71: A bacterial strain used in microbial fungicides. It produces compounds that can affect fungal growth.
deltamethrin: A pyrethroid insecticide. It affects signal transmission in insect nervous systems.
spinosad: An insecticide derived from bacterial fermentation. It affects receptors in insect nervous systems.
bacillus-thuringiensis-subsp-kurstaki: A bacterial subspecies used in microbial insecticides. It produces proteins that act in the gut of certain larvae.
acetamiprid: A neonicotinoid insecticide. It affects receptors in insect nervous systems.
flonicamid: An insecticide that disrupts feeding in certain sap-feeding insects.
lenacil: A herbicide that interferes with photosynthesis.
propyzamide: A herbicide that interferes with plant cell division.
cycloxydim: A herbicide that interferes with fatty-acid production in susceptible grasses.
nitrate-n-14-4-ammonium-n-1-1-cao-26-5: A source of calcium and nitrogen. Calcium contributes to the structure of plant tissues.
calcium-nitrate: A source of calcium and nitrogen. Calcium contributes to the structure of plant tissues.
urea-n-46: A nitrogen fertiliser. Urea changes form in the soil and can supply nitrogen to plants.
urea: A nitrogen fertiliser. Urea changes form in the soil and can supply nitrogen to plants.
nitrate-n-13-k2o-46: A source of potassium and nitrate nitrogen. Potassium contributes to water regulation in plants.
potassium-nitrate: A source of potassium and nitrate nitrogen. Potassium contributes to water regulation in plants.
ammonium-nitrate: A nitrogen fertiliser containing nitrogen in ammonium and nitrate forms.
npk: A group of fertilisers containing nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium. The label states the actual composition.
